@slug: mentalist
@realms: Mentalism
@prime_stats: Pr, SD
@description:
 Mentalists are pure spell users of Mentalism who have concentrated on spells
 that deal with the interaction of minds. Their base spells deal with the
 detection of mental Presence, mental communication, mind control, mind
 attack, mind merging, and sense control.
